jobs.title: Principal Industrial Designer
jobs.desc:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.
Principal Industrial Designer - Mouse Design Team : Cork, Ireland
Hybrid role - base 3 days a week on site*
THE ROLE
Logitech is seeking a Principal Industrial Designer to join our Mouse Design Team in Cork. This is a senior-level position for a recognised expert who balances world-class craft with strategic foresight — a thinker and a doer. You will work on complex design assignments, solving unique challenges that have a broad impact on our product portfolio and the future direction of our businesses.
Based in our Cork office, you will be a key member of a team dedicated to excellence in handheld products, leading the creation of mice that are as comfortable, ergonomically superior as they are visually groundbreaking.
WHY IS THIS ROLE IMPORTANT FOR LOGITECH?
The mouse is at the core of Logitech's product portfolio. We design the tools people reach for every day - products where form, material, ergonomics, and engineering precision must coexist seamlessly and where world class design quality is non-negotiable. At the Principal level, you will be shaping the future of one of our most competitive and scrutinised product categories. We prototype to learn, design to inspire, and ship real products that people enthuse about and love to use.
YOUR CONTRIBUTION
Move fast. Speak up. Decide and own. Drive change.
Visionary Craft & Innovation: Lead the design and development of future-forward mouse experiences, transforming complex human problems into polished, intuitive, and beautiful design solutions.
Strategic Influence: Partner with senior leadership to shape the long-term direction of the Mouse Design Team, ensuring design strategy aligns with emerging trends and business objectives.
Design Excellence: Manage key design processes and projects from brief through to production builds, maintaining an unrelenting focus on quality, detail, and creative confidence.
Mentorship & Leadership: Provide guidance and thought leadership to the broader design team. Mentor other designers and foster a culture of curiosity and exceptional craftsmanship.
Collaborative Networking: Build strong relationships with engineering, product marketing, and business stakeholders to drive design quality and change across a multidisciplinary environment.
Key Qualifications
To be considered, you must bring the following minimum skills and behaviours to our team:
Proven Track Record: 10+ years of relevant experience in Industrial Design, either in-house or at a leading agency, with a portfolio of successful, high-volume consumer hardware products.
Physical-Digital Mastery: Exceptional hands-on skills in sketching, visualisation, and physical prototyping (including hand-sculpting in foam). Deep understanding of anthropometrics, ergonomics, and the iterative digital-to-physical workflow required for handheld devices.
3D CAD Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in surface CAD - excellent working knowledge of Rhino, SolidWorks, Alias, Fusion or Creo Parametric, Class-A surfacing principles and experience exchanging high-quality 3D files with mechanical engineers and CAD specialists.
CMF & Manufacturing: Working expertise in Materials, Colours and Finishes, Design for Manufacturing, and EVT/DVT/PVT build processes — you understand how to maintain design intent through engineering development.
AI Proficiency: Comfortable integrating AI tools (e.g., Vizcom, Gemini, Magnific) into ideation and concept visualisation workflows. Able to move faster and explore more broadly because of it - not instead of core craft.
Communication & Storytelling: Able to craft compelling design narratives and present persuasively to stakeholders at all levels, from engineers to senior executives.
Highly driven, collaborative, and a proactive self-starter — you take on ambiguous assignments and drive them through to valuable outcomes.
Education: Bachelor's degree or higher in Industrial Design, Product Design, or a related field.
OUR CULTURE
At Logitech, we act like a small company. We believe that anyone can have the best idea. We value designers who are humble, hungry, and brave enough to challenge conventional thinking — and we offer a highly collaborative, international environment where your work will impact millions of people worldwide.
Logitech is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment at Logitech are considered without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or sexual orientation.
Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere, without compromising on productivity or continuity so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are open to work from home from most locations. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on-premises. Within this structure, you may have teams or departments split between working remotely and working in-house.
Logitech is an amazing place to work because it is full of authentic people who are inclusive by nature as well as by design. Being a global company, we value our diversity and celebrate all our differences. Don’t meet every single requirement? Not a problem. If you feel you are the right candidate for the opportunity, we strongly recommend that you apply. We want to meet you!
We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits packages and working environments that are designed to be flexible and help you to care for yourself and your loved ones, now and in the future. We believe that good health means more than getting medical care when you need it. Logitech supports a culture that encourages individuals to achieve good physical, financial, emotional, intellectual and social wellbeing so we all can create, achieve and enjoy more and support our families. We can’t wait to tell you more about them being that there are too many to list here and they vary based on location.

Design, implement, and integrate high-quality synthesizable RTL using SystemVerilog.
Translate architectural specifications into robust, efficient microarchitectures and RTL implementations.
Work with architects and senior engineers to understand functional and performance requirements.
Develop RTL that meets requirements for performance, power, area, and functionality.
Participate in RTL design reviews and contribute to design methodology and coding standards.
Develop and maintain unit-level and block-level test environments in collaboration with verification engineers.
Debug functional issues using simulation, waveform analysis, assertions, and other verification tools.
Work with verification teams to identify, reproduce, and resolve RTL design issues.
Collaborate with physical design engineers to understand and address timing, area, power, and implementation constraints.
Support synthesis, timing analysis, linting, CDC analysis, and other front-end quality checks.
Contribute to integration of internally developed and third-party IP.
Help investigate and resolve issues encountered during integration and downstream implementation.
Document design decisions, interfaces, microarchitecture, implementation details and reviews within the PSG Quality Management System (QMS)
Contribute to continuous improvement of RTL methodologies, automation, and development flows.
Work alongside senior engineers to develop solutions to challenging customer and internal silicon problems.
Technical Scope
Depending On Experience, The Role May Encompass Areas Including
SystemVerilog RTL
SoC and subsystem design
CPU, GPU, AI/ML, networking, or other high-performance compute architectures
Control logic and datapaths
Memory interfaces and controllers
High-speed interfaces
Clock and reset architectures
AMBA protocols such as AXI, AHB, and APB
IP integration
Low-power design techniques
Assertions and formal verification
RTL synthesis and optimization
Static analysis, lint, and CDC
Performance and power optimization
RTL-to-gates implementation flows
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
10+ years of relevant RTL/ASIC design experience.
Proficiency in Verilog or SystemVerilog.
Understanding of digital logic design and synchronous design principles.
Experience developing synthesizable RTL for ASIC or FPGA implementations.
Familiarity with simulation and RTL debugging.
Understanding of common SoC interfaces and protocols.
Basic understanding of synthesis, timing, and physical implementation considerations.
Ability to analyze complex technical problems and develop practical solutions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary engineering team.
Ability to communicate effectively to customers
What Success Looks Like
Deliver robust RTL. Develop clean, maintainable, synthesizable RTL that meets functional and performance requirements.
Think beyond the RTL. Understand how design decisions affect verification, synthesis, timing, power, area, and ultimately silicon.
Solve problems independently. Take ownership of assigned blocks and issues while knowing when to seek guidance from more senior engineers.
Work collaboratively. Build strong working relationships with architects, verification, physical design, and other Silicon Engineering teams.
Learn quickly. Develop expertise in new architectures, technologies, methodologies, and Cadence tools as projects evolve.
Grow into technical leadership. Develop the depth and breadth needed to take ownership of increasingly complex blocks and eventually lead technical areas within the Silicon Engineering organisation.
Why Join the PSG Team?
This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced semiconductor technology, EDA, and real silicon.
You will work on problems that are often at the limits of what current design methodologies and technologies can achieve, collaborating with some of the world's leading semiconductor companies and technology partners.
Rather than being limited to a single product or stage of the design flow, you will have the opportunity to influence the entire path from technology and methodology through to working silicon.
If you are an engineer who wants to solve the industry's hardest silicon problems—and see those solutions become real products—this is the team for you.
Additional Information
Cadence is committed to equal employment opportunity and employment equity throughout all levels of the organization. We strive to attract a qualified and diverse candidate pool and encourage diversity and inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.desc:
We’re a global team of over 400 people, working together to push the boundaries of open-source technology and multi-cloud solutions. Our vision is to help developers, builders, and creators bring their ideas to life with speed and simplicity, by providing a cloud data platform that makes open-source databases, search, streaming, and application infrastructure easily accessible to everyone.
The Role:
We're looking for a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own the end-to-end user journey for Aiven's self-serve customer base. This role is deeply focused on what happens after someone signs up — turning new users into activated ones, activated users into paying customers, and paying customers into expanded accounts.
You'll combine segmentation, behavioural data, and personalised messaging to build a lifecycle program that drives measurable monetisation outcomes. This includes everything from in-console nudges to nurture flows to expansion signals.
What You'll Do:
Own the full user lifecycle from sign-up through activation, conversion, retention, and expansion
Design and execute nurture programs tailored to where users are in their journey — onboarding sequences, re-engagement flows, and milestone-based triggers
Build and manage in-console messaging and product nudges in partnership with Product — surfacing the right prompt to the right user at the right moment
Develop and maintain user segmentation frameworks based on product usage, firmographics, and behavioural signals
Drive monetisation programs: identifying users with high conversion or expansion potential and delivering targeted interventions (upgrade prompts, usage-based triggers, tier nudges)
Work closely with Product and Data teams to define the signals that indicate activation, health, and churn risk — and build automated responses to them
Own lifecycle reporting: activation rates, conversion rates, expansion revenue influenced, and churn metrics
What We're Looking For:
Proven experience in lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing, ideally at a SaaS or PLG company
Deep understanding of user journey mapping and funnel-based thinking
You're highly data-driven, you can build a cohort, read a funnel, and turn behavioural signals into a clear hypothesis worth testing.
Experience with marketing automation and lifecycle tooling (e.g. Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, or similar)
Familiarity with in-product messaging tools (e.g. Intercom, Pendo, or similar) is a strong plus
Strong collaboration skills, this role sits at the intersection of Marketing, Product, and Data
